note: The buyer's policy for the board at Assembly L4: the L3 policy, plus an inspection by an independent lab of a seeded sample of at least two boards, which the lab commits to before the EMS seals the lot.

simulated.note: The example's manufacturing is simulated, so this policy accepts records made from simulated hardware. A policy for real parts leaves this out.

inspection.note: Assembly L4: an independent lab X-rays a seeded sample of the boards, checks every marking against the HBOM and challenges every identity part.
